title: Signal Fabric Ingest Optimizer for LLM KPIs
creator: Aisha Mehta
description: We need an optimizer layer in the metrics ingestion path (the 'signal fabric') that reduces downstream cardinality explosion and stabilizes per-model LLM KPIs (latency, error rate, tokens/req) without losing fidelity required for SLO computation. This ticket implements a routing/aggregation sidecar that applies workload-aware sharding, dynamic rollup windows, and deterministic exemplar tagging for trace linkage. The new component should be pluggable into both the OTLP ingestion fleet and the Prometheus scrape/adapter flow so it can operate as an ingest-time transformer for hosted and dedicated telemetry streams.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Ingest optimizer deployed in staging and processing 100% of OTA telemetry for a subset of tenants; 2) End-to-end latency to metric availability does not increase by >250ms on median; 3) Cardinality of per-model label sets reduced by >=60% for noisy models while preserved for high-signal tenants; 4) Deterministic exemplars are attached to 100% of sampled request spans for trace->metric linkage; 5) Grafana dashboard shows stable SLI derivation matching pre-rollup baselines within ±3% for 95th percentile latency.
tasks: Design ingest optimizer API and config format (shard rules, rollup profiles, exemplar policy)
Prototype sidecar mapper that accepts OTLP metrics and emits normalized Prometheus-compatible envelopes
Implement deterministic exemplar tagging using request fingerprinting and trace-id enrichment
Integrate with existing telemetry gateway and run compatibility tests with prometheus-adapter
Add e2e test harness that replays historical telemetry and measures cardinality/latency impact
Ship documentation: Confluence design doc, config reference, rollout plan
Create migration playbook for Dedicated and Private tenants
